description: Triage one DeviceCloud run in a single call. Resolves the upload, folds retries per flow, and returns the failed flows with fail reasons, durations, and failure-screenshot paths (auto-downloaded from the HTML report), plus a passed/failed/flaky summary and suggested next steps. The highest-signal tool for debugging a red CI run — use this first, then read the screenshots and fix the flow or app code.

includeReport.description: Download + unzip the HTML report to surface failure screenshots. Default true.

name.description: Upload name; most recent match wins. Provide this or uploadId.

outputDir.description: Parent directory for the extracted report. Defaults to /tmp.

uploadId.description: Upload UUID. Provide this or name.

name: diagnose_run
